about_the_game:
Join our Discord to follow development and leave feedback!

The game is currently under development by Nicolas Nadeau (with help from RYRY77 early in development) as of June 21st 2023 on the Unity engine. Myth of the Moirai is a third-person ARPG with influences from Diablo, Vampire Survivors, Final Fantasy, Dungeons & Dragons and Elder Scrolls. The concept of Myth of the Moirai started as a "Vampire Survivors with WoW Camera and Diablo pacing, itemization, and character progression." but soon grew into much more when we implemented dynamic procedurally generated terrain, and the ability to add random "landmarks" and events to our infinite random world.






Myth of the Moirai will first release as a free demo, it will have Act 1 which will include 15 of these random landmarks and quests to complete as you gain levels as well as a Diablo style itemization system. The world is also filled with monsters that have it out for you, as soon as you leave town, you will immediately start getting chased down by the monsters that have overtaken this world, so mow them down and get stronger to fight the stronger enemies that lie ahead of you. Check out the gallery section of the discord to see some screenshots of the game in its current state. Finish Act 1 in the Demo and look out for the rest of the Acts and a PVP zone in the endgame. Demo coming SOON!





Future Content:
Acts 2-4 and a PvP/PvE Act5
More Skills for the Mage and a Skill Tree
More Characters including: Warrior, Rogue, Necromancer, and Priest
Co-op Multiplayer
PvP Multiplayer
Crafting
Property Ownership and Building
Trading
Damage types and Resistances
Cutscenes
All assets will be replaced over time with higher quality assets
